attacks.name: Biomorphic Arsenal
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical|, |!energy|, or |!mystic|.
After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

|!wild| |*Cower Before Me|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains either the |§shock§Shock| or |§root§Root| special condition. Then, if the defender already had the Shock and Root special conditions before this attack was chosen, Throw it Away |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: En Sabah Nur's Judgment
steps: Add 2 dice to this attack roll for each special condition the defender has.

superPowers.name: Apocalypse's Horsemen (Affiliation: Servants of the Apocalypse)
superPowers.body: When this Leadership is chosen, this character is assigned the |*Master of the Horsemen| Card. Then you may assign the |*Death|, |*Famine|, |*Pestilence|, and |*War| Horsemen Cards to eligible |*Servants of the Apocalypse| characters in your Squad. No character may be assigned more than one Horsemen Card.

superPowers.name: Celestial Technology
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, Choose up to two other allied characters within |!range| 5 of this character. Each chosen character drops all objective tokens they are holding and is Placed within |!range| 1 of this character.

superPowers.name: You Will be Remade Through Me
superPowers.body: When an enemy character within |!range| 5 of this character would gain a special condition it already has, this character may use this superpower. The enemy character gains the |§bleed§Bleed|, |§shock§Shock|, |§slow§Slow|, or |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition instead. A character can be affected by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Only the Strong Remain
superPowers.body: After an attack against this character is resolved, if this character suffered |!damage|, it may remove 1 |!damage| from itself. Additionally, once per Turn when this character would gain a special condition it is immune to, after the effect is resolved, it may either gain 1 |!power| or remove 1 |!damage| from itself.
